fields: L4 Beijing / Chinese New Year (tricycle; Shichahai hutong → Chang'an Avenue → Summer Palace). Same item fields as L3 v3.1. Per run: 5 riddle-stand + 4 fork + 1 final = 10. Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Lantern riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'). Stems are deduped against all L1–L3 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: 一群鸽子原有 9 只，每年变成原来的 2 倍，3 年后有多少只？
questions.qtype_zh: 指数增长/衰减求值（翻倍、等比）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Two hutong lanes of 16 m and 6 m meet at 60°. How far apart are their ends, in metres?
questions.q_zh: 两条胡同长 16 米和 6 米，夹角 60°，两端相距多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A hutong ramp forms a right triangle: rise 6, run 8, slope length 10. What is tan of the angle at the bottom?
questions.q_zh: 胡同里一段坡道构成直角三角形：高 6、水平 8、斜边 10，底角的 tan 值是多少？

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Families on the bridge watch the full moon on the Lantern Festival. Why is the moon full on about the 15th of a lunar month?
questions.q_zh: 元宵夜一家人在桥上赏满月。为什么农历十五前后月亮最圆？
choices: Months start at new moon; half a synodic month later the Moon is opposite the Sun
The Moon makes its own light on the 15th
choices_zh: 农历月从新月开始，约半个朔望月后月亮转到与太阳相对的位置
十五那天月亮自己发光
questions.explain_en: New moon starts the month; about 14–15 days later the Moon is opposite the Sun and fully lit.
questions.explain_zh: 初一是新月，十四五天后月亮与太阳相对，被照亮的一面全朝向地球。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Over Kunming Lake a deep-red firework bursts. Which explanation is correct?
questions.q_zh: 昆明湖上空炸开一朵深红色烟花。哪种解释正确？
choices: Strontium salts; excited electrons emit red light as they drop
Copper salts; they reflect the lanterns
No metal; red is just smoke
choices_zh: 锶盐；受激电子回落时放出红光
questions.explain_en: Strontium's emission lines are red.
questions.explain_zh: 锶的发射光谱在红光区。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A ramp up to the Seventeen-Arch Bridge rises 9 m over a horizontal run of 12 m, with a sloping length of 15 m. What is sin of the ramp's angle?
questions.q_zh: 上十七孔桥的坡道升高 9 米，水平距离 12 米，斜长 15 米。坡角的 sin 值是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A firework over the bridge follows h = -4t² + 32t (h in tens of metres, t in seconds). What is its maximum height h?
questions.q_zh: 桥上空一枚烟花的高度 h = -4t² + 32t（h 单位十米，t 单位秒），最大高度 h 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: From a boat on Kunming Lake, the two ends of the Seventeen-Arch Bridge are 21 and 5 units away, with a 60° angle between the sight lines. How long is the bridge in those units?
questions.q_zh: 在昆明湖的船上看十七孔桥两端，距离分别是 21 和 5 个单位，两条视线夹角 60°。桥长多少个单位？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A lantern string runs 20 m from the bridge deck up to a lamp post at 30° above horizontal. How high is the top of the string above the deck, in metres?
questions.q_zh: 一串彩灯从桥面拉到灯杆上，长 20 米，与水平面成 30°。彩灯顶端离桥面多高（米）？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A firework over Kunming Lake rises with height h = -2t² + 7t (in tens of metres). What is h at t = 2?
questions.q_zh: 昆明湖上空一枚烟花的高度是 h = -2t² + 7t（单位：十米），t = 2 时 h 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a park grid (units of 10 m), the Seventeen-Arch Bridge's east end is at (-3, 3) and Flora's tricycle is at (0, 7). What is the straight-line distance in grid units?
questions.q_zh: 在公园坐标图上（单位 10 米），十七孔桥东头在 (-3, 3)，Flora 的三轮车在 (0, 7)，两点直线距离是几个单位？
